verdict.rationale: The pack makes privacy-posture claims: prompts are never tracked or trained on, and local runs never leave the machine. It documents no user-facing control over how long data is retained or how it is deleted, particularly for cloud usage. The community mention of 'ollama rm' covers removing models, not user data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
